train.explanation: 439 clips from 75 videos: each video with n>=T frames gives floor((n-8)/2)+1 clips (stride 2), +1 tail-anchored clip when (n-8) % 2 != 0; videos with n<8 give 1 padded clip.

val.explanation: 67 clips from 19 videos: each video with n>=T frames gives floor((n-8)/4)+1 clips (stride 4), +1 tail-anchored clip when (n-8) % 4 != 0; videos with n<8 give 1 padded clip.
